blocks.en: We say that $B$ is compact relative to $A$ if $\mathcal{D}(B)\supseteq\mathcal{D}(A)$ and if $Bx_n$ has a convergent subsequence whenever $x_n\in\mathcal{D}(A)$ and $\|Ax_n\|_Y+\|x_n\|_X$ is bounded. Assume that $A$ is closed, $B$ is closable and that $B$ is compact relative to $A$. Show that $B$ is bounded relative to $A$ and the constant $a$ in Problem~\ref{ex:closed-unbounded-resolvent-analyticity} can be made arbitrarily small. Hint: Try to imitate the proof of Ehrling\textquotesingle s lemma (Lemma~\ref{thm:ehrling-compact-intermediate-norm}).
blocks.zh: 若 $\mathcal{D}(B)\supseteq\mathcal{D}(A)$, 且只要 $x_n\in\mathcal{D}(A)$ 及 $\|Ax_n\|_Y+\|x_n\|_X$ 有界, $Bx_n$ 就有收敛子序列, 则称 $B$ 相对于 $A$ 紧. 假设 $A$ 是闭的, $B$ 是可闭的, 且 $B$ 相对于 $A$ 紧. 证明 $B$ 相对于 $A$ 有界, 并且 Problem~\ref{ex:closed-unbounded-resolvent-analyticity} 中的常数 $a$ 可以任意小. Hint: 尝试仿照 Ehrling 引理 (Lemma~\ref{thm:ehrling-compact-intermediate-norm}) 的证明.
blocks.label: ex:relative-compactness-arbitrarily-small-relative-bound
